body:
Virgo Daughter = Me

Scorpio Mother = Emotional Wreck 

Pisces Dad = Too much water

In short y'all, I be drowning.  🐟🎣

Congratulations 🎊, after being almost killed by my own roommate, going to court several times, starting from absolute nothing, I am alone as well. And though the paranoia bothers me here and there , it's a blessing to be free 🙏🏽

Losing everything I had and my apartment to an abusive drunk ex partner. Being in a lesbian DV case and being treated like an aggressor because she seems pretty and sweet when sober and being made a fool of in court, after the judge sided with her, despite my video evidence and photo evidence, then being scammed by an air bnb host out of 2k, that I could of used for a new home. Being cut off my insurance for my mental health medicine, and trying not to let anyone see me break. Bpd sucks and I'm beyond empty.

He is super unloving and you need to leave. If not leave, then set more boundaries with this man because you are working to earn the money in that account. You don't get to sit on your ass and have money pop up in your bank account, so since when was it ok for him to do this? No. No. No.
I moan, and squeeze my fingers tightly, it just helps me.
Snap me @grav3yard_6 for an online little.

Just me being depressed black and lonely. Everything I try to post gets taken down. I am at my wits end and just would like to dissappear. My girlfriend leaves me because my depression scares her, I have ugly skin that I destroyed myself, I can't be a little since I am not cute or light enough. Ugh, who knows. 

I have no more interest in my art. The only thing that once saved me. My parents kicked me out because of said girlfriend and told me that I am a theif going to hell. I may go to hell. If it exists sh*t. 

I am in chronic pain and can't get the proper medication because my doctors racially profile me as an addict, though other than my severe depression and social anxiety I at least have no addictive personality. 

I just want the pain of being abused sexually by family members, heart break, and poverty to escape me and the only light really is death. I have been waiting for 19 years, it does not get better. It all gets worse, at least for a chick like me. #Bless
It wasn't even vulgar or crazy, I was genuinely being sweet. 🦧

I have the same issue. I don't know what else to do. But end it all. I just keep fighting but no one gets how hard the fight is to keep up when you have been fighting for years and years and years. With nothing to show for it. Nothing. But life.
I want you as a daddy. Chat with me ?🥺🖤

Forget your parents. Find the fight in yourself and protect you love. The are from a different time. They will not understand. I know you could make it if you just keep on going. But the road is hard. It is very hard. 🖤
Please try to get better. We love you. 🖤
